name: ThermAI-Control
description: "ThermAI-Control is a reproducible simulation-generated benchmark for developing and evaluating artificial-intelligence controllers for liquid-cooled electronics thermal management. The dataset contains 18,060 synchronized time-series observations from 60 randomized 600-s trials, comprising 20 trials each for proportional\u2013integral\u2013derivative control, model-predictive control, and a constrained physics-guided AI policy. Each run combines randomized ambient conditions, base heat loads, and two transient heat pulses. Logged variables include heater power, junction, coolant and ambient temperatures, pump and fan commands, coolant flow, actuator power, cumulative cooling energy, effective cold-plate resistance, heat-rejection conductance, and safety state. Run-level records provide peak and mean junction temperatures, time above 75\u00b0C, post-pulse settling time, cooling energy, maximum temperature ramp, a composite objective, and trip-free completion. Controller-wise train, validation, and test partitions are grouped by run to prevent temporal leakage. The release also includes a data dictionary, nominal apparatus parameters, prospective calibration and uncertainty documentation, an experimental protocol, a machine-readable provenance manifest, and formula-driven summary tables.
